tools.name: random
commitment
tools.description:
Verifiable commit-reveal. operation selects the step:
  commit -- hash a seed, bind it to draw_spec {operation, params}, attest via Stamp. The seed is returned to the caller and never stored.
  reveal -- verify a seed against commitment_id, re-execute the draw deterministically, attest the outcome.

tools.name: test
tools.description: Statistical battery over a sequence: frequency, chi-squared, runs, longest run, serial correlation, Shannon entropy, KS, gap test. Informed by NIST SP 800-22; no certification claimed. sequence is a list of numbers, list of strings, or a hex/base64 byte string.

tools.name: explore
tools.description: Bandit arm selection: epsilon_greedy, thompson, or ucb1. Stateless -- caller passes state in as {arm: {pulls, successes, total_reward}} and gets a selection back. params: {epsilon} for epsilon_greedy.
